verdict.rationale: Conductor is a Mac app for running coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode in parallel, each in its own workspace. An AI coding tool could plausibly ship inline completions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only agent orchestration, workspaces, diffs and review, with no inline code completions or next-edit suggestions as the developer types.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
